country: Cong Hoa Xa Hoi Chu Nghia Viet Nam

fields.climate: tropical in south; monsoonal in north with hot, rainy season (May to September) and warm, dry season (October to March)
fields.terrain: low, flat delta in south and north; central highlands; hilly, mountainous in far north and northwest
fields.hazards: occasional typhoons (May to January) with extensive flooding, especially in the Mekong River delta
fields.resources: antimony, phosphates, coal, manganese, rare earth elements, bauxite, chromate, offshore oil and gas deposits, timber, hydropower, arable land
fields.farm: rice, vegetables, sugarcane, cassava, maize, pork, fruits, bananas, coconuts, coffee
fields.exports: broadcasting equipment, garments, integrated circuits, machine parts, footwear
fields.industries: food processing, garments, shoes, machine-building; mining, coal, steel; cement, chemical fertilizer, glass, tires, oil, mobile phones
fields.languages: Vietnamese (official); English (often as a second language); some French, Chinese, and Khmer; mountain-area languages (including Mon-Khmer and Malayo-Polynesian)
fields.legal: civil law system with European influences
fields.military: 18-27 years of age for compulsory and voluntary military service for men and women (in practice only men are drafted)…
